scope: Manage-only browser workflows for Fiscal Identity create/update and DRAFT Sales Invoice Header Profile create/edit.

authorityBoundary.browser: Collects permitted administrative input and displays authoritative Central PMS responses.
authorityBoundary.centralPms: Authenticated browser-facing API boundary that derives actor identity and enforces Site/resource scope.
authorityBoundary.posServer: Authoritative Fiscal Identity and Sales Invoice Header Profile persistence, validation, lifecycle, overlap, approval, retirement, readiness, and usage authority.

siteScope.source: Current authorized Management Platform Site context.
siteScope.siteSwitchWithUnsavedChanges: Requires confirmation before discarding unsaved in-memory form state.

actorDerivationBoundary.derivedBy: Central PMS backend from the authenticated Management Platform principal.

mutationRetry: Mutation requests are sent once and are not automatically retried.
uncertainResultBehavior: Timeout or connection-loss mutation failures show refresh-and-verify guidance with a safe correlation support reference when available.

errorMapping.403: Insufficient Manage permission or Site scope.
errorMapping.404: Fiscal Identity or Header Profile no longer exists.
errorMapping.409: Duplicate version, lifecycle conflict, overlap, immutability, or invalid state.
errorMapping.504: Mutation result is uncertain. Refresh and verify before retrying.

browserSecurity.browserStorage: Fiscal Identity, Header Profile, statutory fields, credentials, and Site authorization are not stored in localStorage, sessionStorage, or IndexedDB.

playwrightE2eAutomation.serverLifecycle: Playwright starts and stops controlled Vite development and production-preview servers automatically.
automatedScenarioCoverage: Fiscal Identity create success and conflict
Fiscal Identity update success and immutability conflict
DRAFT Header Profile create success, conflict, and timeout uncertainty
DRAFT Header Profile edit success and conflict
forbidden, disabled, and unavailable manage postures
browser route, header, storage, and console safety
browserSecurityAssertions: all browser API requests remain under /v1/management-platform
no downstream POS Server administration header is sent
no POS Server URL or API key is exposed
no profile or credential browser storage is used
playwrightE2eAutomation.productionScenarioIsolation: Production build ignores mpScenario and mpProfileScenario and exposes no development scenario indicator.
playwrightE2eAutomation.generatedArtifactPosture: Screenshots, traces, videos, and reports are generated evidence only and are ignored by Git.
manualSmokeAfterAutomation: confirm no Approve or Retire controls

accessibility: field errors are associated through a validation summary
keyboard users can submit and cancel
status is not conveyed by color alone
